claim_summaries.summary: On a fixed connected Sol mapping torus, smooth bump perturbations have normalized entropy-power deficit tending to zero while the L-infinity strain gap stays bounded below and sectional curvature diverges.
On the same mapping torus, explicit high-frequency metrics have fixed entropy, deficit 2*pi^2/n, uniformly convergent strain, and unbounded sectional curvature.
A fixed-volume, fixed-entropy H=1 sequence of exact Sol equality examples has injectivity radius tending to zero and curvature tending to infinity.
Exact covers have unbounded diameter; disconnected Sol-plus-zero mixtures realize the exact support-fraction deficit; time rescaling preserves equality while sending entropy and work to zero.

status: frozen independent initial; external correctness and novelty unverified; no field-breaking claim
